title: FleetHealthSummaryEvent
description: Schema for Service Manager message SM6. This event publishes an aggregate fleet health summary after the Service Manager processes Sentinel heartbeat information and updates its registry.

type.description: NGSI-LD entity type. It has to be fleetHealthSummaryEvent.

originator.description: Property. Component that generated the event.

messageId.description: Property. Unique identifier of this published message.

correlationId.description: Property. Identifier used to correlate this event with the continuous health-monitoring flow.

timestamp.description: Property. Date and time at which the fleet health summary event was generated.

totalSentinels.description: Property. Total number of Sentinels registered in the fleet.

healthySentinels.description: Property. Number of Sentinels currently classified as healthy.

degradedSentinels.description: Property. Number of Sentinels currently classified as degraded.

offlineSentinels.description: Property. Number of Sentinels currently classified as offline.

lastUpdated.description: Property. Date and time at which the fleet health summary was last updated in the Service Manager registry.
